tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and dark buttons. 16.6:1 on `paper`, 18.6:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy (descriptions, review text) on `paper` and `surface` (10.4:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, labels, captions on `surface` (4.6:1). On `paper` it is 4.1:1 — below 4.5:1, keep it to 14px+ meta lines there (source value kept).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, dividers inside dark panels. Fails as text on light grounds (2.2:1 on `paper`); reads on `night` (7.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and card outlines, dividers between rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, empty-state dashed outlines.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (warm sand) on every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets, nav pills sitting on `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken panels: kanban columns, upload drop zones, modal footers.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark hero bands, brand panels, footer and admin sidebar. Pair with `surface` text.

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: Raised elements inside `night` panels (testimonial cards, chips on dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Majorelle blue. Primary buttons, active states, links, selected borders, focus rings. 7.3:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of `brand` fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected backgrounds (role cards, radio cards), avatar fill, info banners. `brand` text on it is 6.8:1.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-soft` when extra weight is needed (avatar initials, 12.7:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `success` fills (8.1:1 on `brand`).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Accent: rating stars, the logo dot, highlight word in heroes, seller CTA band. Use `ink` text on it (9.3:1); never white.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent background (how-it-works step, “#1 in city” badge).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Inspected / pass / approved / accepting requests. Also the Accept and Approve buttons.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and notices (`success` text 4.7:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention / pending states. On `warning-soft` only 3.5:1 — use it at 12px medium in badges with a dot, not for paragraphs (source value kept).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of pending / attention badges and the unverified-email notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fail / rejected / destructive actions, form errors, favourite heart fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, danger buttons and error notices (`danger` text 4.6:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-progress state, neutral information notices. 4.5:1 on `info-soft` (just under — keep to medium weight).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and notices.
